Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.19.0
Entries.Description: Welcome [@t0stbrot.net](https://t0stbrot.net/) as new project to which you can contribute from your location anonymously. It's a recently established project which warmly welcomes new contributors. It's enabled by default so feel free to contribute!
Messages: Fix GPS status not updated immediately when the location is obtained.
Replace toast notification with snackbar with Stop action when another task is currently running in background.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.18.0
Messages: Hide 'Project support' link on Google Play's app version.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.17.3
Messages: Update background location permission rationale to satisfy Google Play Prominent Disclosure requirement.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.17.2
Messages: Fix 'Unknown' network type not handled correctly when uploading measurements to BeaconDB.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.17.1
Messages: Change auto update check service address to a new domain.

Entries.Title: Changes in version 2.17.0
Messages: Fix Stop not working on Collector notification on Android 15.
Implement measurement collection throttling - you can now define how often measurements are saved.
Remove GPS battery optimizations - it caused issues on some devices and batteries improved a lot over time.
Add monochrome icon for more personalized experience.
